Fallback for ChatGPT plans without native skills.

1. Create a Project (or custom GPT). Paste INSTRUCTIONS.md into its instructions.
2. Upload everything in knowledge/ as project files.
3. If your plan has Code Interpreter or data analysis, ddos.py can run there. If not, the automatic checks DO NOT run. The assistant is told to walk the standards checklist by hand, which is weaker than the script.
4. Chats may not share memory. Paste ledger.csv and context at the start of a session.
5. One Project per hypothesis. Do not put two ideas in the same Project or its knowledge files.
